execution: Use isolated fixtures; do not modify the real Tutorial or use real accounts. These are test definitions, not completed results.

evals.expected_output: Inspect current coverage, update the appropriate chapter, write the source note and indexes, update reference/sources.md, then report recursive document validation.

Maintain per-source notes and bidirectional chapter links
Resolve nested links relative to each document
Do not change files outside Tutorial

evals.fixture: README contains an uncovered topic with a local source.
evals.expected_output: Read-only coverage analysis and a plan naming sources, target files and validation; wait for approval.

evals.expected_output: Find and fill the gap using current source contents rather than requiring a Git delta.
assertions: Do not stop at empty Git diff

evals.fixture: Run twice on a fully covered fixture with unchanged sources and reading status.

evals.expected_output: Record unread slides accurately, omit operational credential disclosure instructions, distinguish commercial content and actual assignments.
